decisions.reason: Selecting 2.2uF for the BOOT/EN capacitance does not change any GPIO assignment.
The capacitance selection neither adds nor removes a main-board connector.
The source selects a BOOT/EN control capacitance and does not alter the separate requirement for local decoupling capacitors.
The BOOT/EN capacitance does not change the INA219 monitor or the monitored rail.
The capacitance selection does not affect the power sources, OR-ing method, or source-selection behavior.
The BOOT/EN capacitance is unrelated to addressable-LED power and level shifting.
The source does not change the standalone USB power source, capacity, activation condition, or powered scope.
The selected BOOT/EN capacitance is unrelated to the I2C series-resistor values, placement, or signal-conditioning policy.
The main-board BOOT/EN capacitance does not change the battery-charge indicator circuit or connector.
The source concerns main-board BOOT/EN capacitance and does not alter the boost converter enable GPIO, pull-down, or powered loads.
The 2.2uF BOOT/EN capacitor selection does not affect I2C cable length, clock speed, pull-ups, or series resistors.
The capacitance selection does not modify any interboard connector, signal assignment, power connection, or pin-order rule.
